title: La langosta azul
text: La langosta azul es una película de ficción, surrealista publicado en 1954 dirigido por Álvaro Cepeda Samudio, Enrique Grau Araújo, Luis Vicens, y Gabriel García Márquez, quienes después se convertirían en los grandes artistas y personajes de la cultura colombiana.

title: Publication of Yves Peintures (in Madrid), the first public showing of Yves Klein's work.
text: Yves Klein was a French artist and an important figure in postwar European art. He was a leading member of the French artistic movement of Nouveau réalisme, founded in 1960 by art critic Pierre Restany.

title: Pablo Picasso begins painting his Les Femmes d'Alger ("The Women of Algiers") series in homage to Delacroix's 1834 painting of the same name and to the memory of Matisse.
text: Pablo Ruiz Picasso was a Spanish painter, sculptor, printmaker, and ceramicist who spent most of his adult life in France.
